recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-19708 unless a future Pharmacy decision changes medication category cardinality policy.
issue_request: FHIR-19708 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request asking to relax category cardinality from 0..1 to 0..* for medication resources. The voted resolution was to change MedicationAdministration.category, MedicationDispense.category, and MedicationStatement.category to 0..* so they match MedicationRequest.category.
initial_application: The Jira snapshot records application on 18Feb2019 in HL7/fhir commit aa42e5dcc1e780bf1fa001dc784d2801f6d3b1d4. That merge contains commit 9d4a0fe09370e2b75ede4debcff124f36c3d3d7e, which changed the then-authoritative medication spreadsheets for MedicationAdministration.category, MedicationDispense.category, and MedicationStatement.category from 0..1 to 0..*; MedicationRequest.category was already 0..*.
additional_context: The resource source was later reworked for the new build core in 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157, replacing the old medication spreadsheets with active structuredefinition source files. source/fhir.ini keeps MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement active and approved. Current source also shows AdverseEvent.category at 0..*, but the FHIR-19708 resolution did not require an AdverseEvent edit.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active current structure definitions have max="*" for MedicationAdministration.category, MedicationDispense.category, MedicationStatement.category, MedicationRequest.category, and the related AdverseEvent.category.

evidence_items.command: for f in source/medicationadministration/structuredefinition-MedicationAdministration.xml source/medicationdispense/structuredefinition-MedicationDispense.xml source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml source/adverseevent/structuredefinition-AdverseEvent.xml; do awk '/<element id=\"(MedicationAdministration|MedicationDispense|MedicationStatement|MedicationRequest|AdverseEvent)\\.category\">/{in_el=1} in_el && /<path value=/{path=$0} in_el && /<max value=/{print FILENAME \": \" path \" \" $0; in_el=0}' \"$f\"; done
